basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Top Partner Universities in South Korea: Seoul National University (SNU), Yonsei University, Korea University (KU), KAIST, POSTECH, Sungkyunkwan University (SKKU), Ewha Womans University, Hankuk University of Foreign Studies (HUFS)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all academic disciplines: STEM (Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Materials, Natural Sciences), Social Sciences, Humanities, Economics, International Studies, and Business Administration.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~30 elite Asian leaders and scholars awarded fellowships annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open competition across eligible Asian partner countries; Pakistan is an eligible recipient nation (typically 2 to 5 awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full normative degree duration: 2 years (4 semesters) for Master's; up to 3 years (6 semesters) for PhD

nationality_requirements: Citizens of Asian countries (including Pakistan) who completed previous education outside South Korea
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; completed Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD with top academic standing.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.50+ / 4.00 CGPA (or top 10% class standing) from a prestigious university.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Academic background aligned with target graduate school in South Korea.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating prior to autumn semester.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Leadership experience, community engagement, and research achievements evaluated positively.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 85, IELTS Academic min 6.5, or official Medium of Instruction certificate from English-medium university.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Korean proficiency (TOPIK) is optional but viewed favorably for humanities/social science applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Future Asian leaders demonstrating high academic excellence and leadership capability.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not be receiving another Korean government or corporate scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver for normative duration of degree at partner university.

admission_application_fee.details: University admission application fee paid by candidate to partner university.

accommodation.details: Covered via monthly living stipend; priority reservation in partner university international dormitories.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living allowance of KRW 1,000,000/month (~PKR 212,000/month / ~USD $750/month) for the entire duration of studies.

airfare.details: International travel expenses to South Korea borne by candidate.

visa_fee.details: Korean D-2 visa processing fee paid by applicant.

health_insurance.details: National Health Insurance (NHIS) subsidized or covered under university international student health plan.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: University library resources, laboratories, and computing infrastructure provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: POSCO TJ Park Fellowship networking events, Korean cultural excursions, and foundation leadership seminars fully paid.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Full foundation cultural & leadership activities covered

travel_transit_allowance.details: Settlement allowance of KRW 1,000,000 provided once upon initial arrival in South Korea.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple institutions: Partner Korean universities including SNU, Yonsei, Korea Univ, KAIST, POSTECH.
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 1 to 5 in South Korea; Top 100 QS World University Rankings (SNU #31, KAIST #53, Yonsei #56, Korea #67).
available_majors: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Economics, Public Administration, International Relations, Business Administration, Life Sciences
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's/Master's degree from a recognized institution with high GPA and demonstrated leadership qualities.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: SNU and KAIST are the most competitive; candidates must coordinate fellowship application alongside target university admission.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Candidates apply through the POSCO TJ Park Foundation online system in May; upon selection, fellows apply for admission to partner universities for Spring intake.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: POSCO TJ Park Foundation Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the POSCO TJ Park Foundation application portal during the annual application window in May.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Review eligibility and guidelines on POSCO TJ Park website (April).
2. Create account on POSCO foundation portal in early May.
3. Fill out online application form and designate prospective partner universities.
4. Upload Statement of Purpose, academic transcripts, degree certificates, CV, and English proficiency proofs.
5. Upload 2 recommendation letters from academic professors or institutional leaders.
6. Submit online application before end of May deadline.
7. First round: Document evaluation by foundation selection committee.
8. Second round: Video interview conducted in July.
10. Selected fellows apply for university admission to partner Korean university for Spring intake (September-October).
11. Arrive in South Korea in late February.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Sequential: Fellowship awarded by POSCO foundation first, followed by formal university admission application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by applicant or submitted online by referees via foundation portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose describing academic interests, leadership experiences, and vision for fostering cooperation between home country and South Korea.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured study plan outlining proposed graduate research questions, methodology, and career trajectory.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic and leadership CV detailing awards, community projects, and research papers.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Comprehensive 20-30 minute video interview in English testing leadership potential, intellectual depth, and mutual understanding.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: 100% free on POSCO foundation portal; university application fees apply upon admission.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Official university transcripts and degree certificates verified by home university; HEC and Korean Embassy attestation required upon selection.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online through POSCO TJ Park portal.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual cycle: application in May for fellowship; university admission in Autumn; enrollment starts March 1 (Korean Spring semester).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Prior undergraduate/master's GPA and academic prestige of alma mater)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 25% (Community leadership, vision, and potential to lead Asian development)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Quality of essays and commitment to Asian cooperation)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: Decisive during final foundation panel interview
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: POSCO TJ Park Foundation Selection Committee and professors from participating partner universities.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Document screening (Grades + Essays + References) -> Video interview by foundation board -> Final admission placement at partner university.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~30 fellowships awarded annually across all Asian countries
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates from premier national universities (NUST, LUMS, Quaid-i-Azam, UET) with high academic percentiles, demonstrated social leadership, and clear articulation of career vision.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Past Pakistani fellows have pursued graduate degrees at SNU, Yonsei, and KAIST in engineering, public policy, and business.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Vietnam, Indonesia, India, Pakistan, Thailand, Philippines, Bangladesh, Uzbekistan.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: POSCO TJ Park Foundation application is 100% free of charge. Never pay any external agent.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: The foundation does not partner with educational agents or commercial placement firms.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Airfare Pakistan to Seoul Incheon (~PKR 170,000 to 250,000)
University application fees to partner Korean universities (~KRW 80,000 to 100,000 / ~PKR 20,000)
HEC, MOFA, and Korean Embassy document attestation fees
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: Only engineering degrees are eligible. (Truth: Social sciences, business, economics, and humanities at partner universities are fully eligible).
MYTH: You must already be admitted to a Korean university. (Truth: You apply to POSCO foundation first; if selected, you apply for university admission with POSCO sponsorship).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites claim flights are covered; the POSCO Asia Fellowship provides full tuition + monthly stipend + settlement grant, but flight tickets are self-funded.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 out of 4.30 / 4.50 at partner university to renew funding each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance; mandatory participation in annual POSCO Asia Fellowship workshops and ceremonies.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester grade reports submitted directly to POSCO TJ Park Foundation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work permitted per Korean immigration regulations (up to 20-25 hrs/wk), but academic focus expected.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return bond; scholars encouraged to contribute to Asian mutual prosperity.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Active membership in POSCO Asia Fellowship Alumni Network.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding cancelled if fellow fails to achieve minimum GPA, drops out, or acts contrary to foundation regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires prior written consent from POSCO TJ Park Foundation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to 2 years for Master's and 3 years for PhD; no extensions permitted.
